model.purpose: estimate rival auction participation and bid ranges from observed Mister history
model.probability_semantics: estimated chance that a manager participates in the current Mister auction; not probability of winning
model.probability_method: time-validated regularized logistic blend over manager baseline, recent activity, position/value affinity, player momentum, points, historical affordability and roster composition; V75 retained as fallback
model.bid_method: robust weighted quartiles of both winning and losing historical bids relative to contemporaneous VM, shrunk toward manager-wide behavior
model.position_method: current player universe plus full Git snapshot recovery for historical player positions
model.aggressiveness_method: league-relative percentile composite: 45% participation, 35% bid premium vs VM, 20% recent activity
model.confidence_rule: low-confidence forecasts suppress the precise percentage
model.historical_state_method: nearest prior Git snapshot only (no future leakage)

probability_champion.method: recent temporal holdout champion with 0.5% promotion margin
probability_champion.note: complex models remain challengers and are promoted only after out-of-sample evidence

model.bid_range_semantics: low=P25, mid=P50, high=P90; P95 retained for win-probability tail
model.bid_method_v85: winning + losing bids, contemporaneous VM, recency/position/value similarity, manager shrinkage and empirical upper tail

market_demand_gate.principle: manager participation history is conditional on player demand and current manager constraints; full/scarce squads, useful budget and gameweek urgency alter entry probability
market_demand_gate.no_rival_probability: product of visible adjusted non-entry probabilities times Poisson survival for hidden residual rival mass
